slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: Tanzania appears only in the annex's score bands from the October 2016 APAI-CRVS monitoring round: digitisation of the civil registration system under 35% (a composite of electronic recording, notification, transmission, database and ID linkage), and overall system under 35%; its own answers on electronic capture at local offices are not given, so no aspect value can be read, and no system is named.
